96 Sexual Offences Definitive Guideline
Effective from 1 April 2014

PAYING FOR SEX WITH A CHILD

STEP ONE
Determining the offence category
The court should determine which categories of harm and culpability the offence falls into by reference
only to the tables below.
This guideline should only be used where the victim was aged 16 or 17 years old.
Harm

body or object) by, or of, the victim
